tvShow.name: Goodbye, Lara
tvShow.overview: Once upon a time, a mermaid princess named Lara fell in love with a human prince. To be with him, she used a witch’s potion to become human—but the magic came at a cost: If she failed to find true love, she would vanish into sea foam forever. Now, 200 years later, Lara awakens in Lake Biwa with one final chance at life and love.

episodes.name: Mermaid Princess Lara
episodes.overview: Grace, the banished witch, gives Lara, a mermaid princess, a potion that turns her into a human.

episodes.name: Running Through Shiga
episodes.overview: Lara wakes up in the human world in Shiga and encounters Grace in pet fish form, kept by Mari.

episodes.name: Look Away and You Lose
episodes.overview: Lara is curious about "school," and Mari fights her senior to participate in the next boxing tournament.

episodes.name: The Princess and the Prince
episodes.overview: Lara convinces Mari to take her to school and meets Himeka and asks her about her "prince."
